title: Frontend Specialist (Design Systems & Web Performance)
description_raw: We are looking for a dedicated Frontend Specialist passionate about building world-class design systems, pixel-perfect user interfaces, and lightning-fast web applications. In this role, you will define the core component library, establish accessibility standards (WCAG AAA), optimize Core Web Vitals, and champion smooth CSS micro-interactions across our client-facing workspaces.

requirements.requirement_text: 4+ years focused frontend expertise with React, TypeScript, and modern CSS
Experience building and maintaining component libraries or design systems
Deep understanding of browser rendering performance, bundle optimization, and Web Vitals
Expertise in accessibility (a11y), semantic HTML, and ARIA patterns
